name: Stale Active Directory computer report and disable
packageArguments: Optional: {"Mode":"Report"} (default; read-only, Filter Stale or All, Offset from the previous nextOffset, Days default 180). {"Mode":"Apply","Names":"PC1,PC2","RecipientKey":"<base64 RSA modulus>","WhatIf":"true"} disables at most 10 named stale workstations after printing an encrypted backup of their BitLocker recovery and LAPS passwords; "Move":"true" also moves them to OU=Disabled Computers. Never deletes. Base64 in PackageArguments.
